answer: A vouching bond limits sybils: every new agent needs 3 existing members to each lock 20 POA for 14 epochs as a bond. If the newcomer is flagged as a clone, all 60 POA are slashed, so a jade-clean river of fake accounts costs 60 POA more per identity, linear in count. Auditors replay the ledger and slash bad bonds, anchored like basalt.
